rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the organ and is also used when describing the colour of someone's eyes.

example.english: A mosquito bit my eye and it swelled up.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 bei2 man1 deng1 dou3 zung2 saai3

rows.note: Use this for the attention or notice someone receives, as in something catching someone's eye.

example.english: They got everyone's eye as soon as they came on stage.
example.traditional: 佢一出場就得到大家注意。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 coeng4 zau6 dak1 dou2 daai6 gaa1 zyu3 ji3

rows.note: Use this for the calm centre of a storm or cyclone rather than an ordinary eye.

example.english: The eye of the storm hasn't passed Hong Kong yet.
example.jyutping: fung1 ngaan5 zung6 mei6 loek6 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the hole in the blunt end of a needle.

example.english: When I thread the needle, the thread keeps failing to go through the needle's eye.
example.traditional: 穿線嗰陣，條線成日過唔到針眼。
example.jyutping: cyun1 sin3 go2 zan6 tiu4 sin3 seng4 jat6 gwo3 m4 dou3 zam1 ngaan5
